rationale: Qualitative substantival construction ⲡⲉⲧ- + ⲧⲁⲓⲏⲩ 'be honored' (cf. accumulated ⲡⲧⲁⲓⲟ 'honor'). Designates 'the one who has been honored.'
Greek loanword φθονέω/φθόνος. Verbal usage with possessive ⲛⲉⲩ-: 'they envy/begrudge.'
Lyc compound ⲣⲙ̄- ('person of') + ⲛ̄- (genitive) + ⲏⲓ̈ ('house') = 'house-dweller, inhabitant.' Standard Coptic formation.
Lyc qualitative form related to ϣⲟⲟⲡ/ⲟⲩⲱϩ 'dwell, abide.' Used of the inhabitants who 'dwell within' the Land of Light.
Lyc ⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲉ 'pass through, pass by, pass away.' Standard Coptic verb of motion.
Lyc ⲟⲩⲱⲗ 'depart, go away.' Used here as synonymous parallel to ⲟⲩⲓ̈ⲛⲉ 'pass' in describing what does not happen in the Land of Light.
Standard Coptic ⲥⲟⲃⲧ̄/ⲥⲁⲃⲧⲉ 'wall, rampart, fortification.' Here 'wall of fire that surrounds the whole structure' — the cosmic boundary of the Land of Light.

proposed_english: keep watch over / be vigilant over
rationale: Lyc ⲣⲁⲓⲥ = ⲣⲟⲉⲓⲥ 'watch, be vigilant' with directional ⲁⲣⲁ⸗ 'over (them).' The three words of Life keep watch over the works.
ⲥⲏⲩ 'time' + ⲧⲍⲁⲏ = ⲧϩⲁⲏ 'the end, the last.' Standard Manichaean eschatological time-marker.

Lyc plural of ⲙⲁⲛⲭⲟⲣⲉ (in accumulated vocab as 'stronghold/fortress,' ⲙⲁⲛ-ϫⲱⲣⲉ 'place of strength'). Plural here functions as 'mighty beings, strong ones' — divine cosmic powers poured forth by the Father of Life. Chapter title 'Concerning the Mighty Ones' confirms this as the technical term for these three cosmogonic figures.
Standard Coptic ϣⲟⲩⲟ 'pour out' + ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'forth.' Emanative-cosmogonic verb: the Father pours forth the three Mighty Ones.
Lyc form of ⲟⲩⲱⲙ 'eat' (with prosthetic ϣ-). Used in cosmogonic register for the Father's act of incorporation/consumption preceding the casting-down.
Lyc reduplicated form = ϩⲃⲟⲣⲃⲣ̄ 'overthrow, throw down' with 3pl suffix. Maintains downward-throwing semantics, paired with ⲁⲡⲓⲧⲛⲉ 'downward.'
From ⲡⲱⲛⲕ̄ 'scoop, draw out, lift.' Used here of extracting the Mighty Ones from the earth before recasting them.
Verb of unclear etymology, possibly Lyc reflex of a removal/expulsion verb. Context (paired with ⲡⲁⲛⲕ 'draw out' + ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'forth') confirms expulsive direction. Confidence low.
Lyc reflex of ⲡⲁϩⲧ̄ 'cast down, pour out, prostrate.' Downward-directional placement verb.
Lyc plural of ϩⲓⲏ 'way, road.' The three roads correspond to the three paths of judgment (death/life/reconciliation) in Manichaean eschatology.
ⲛⲉⲉ in 'each one to his ⲛⲉⲉ' parallel with 'his appointed time.' Possibly 'place,' 'measure,' or 'lot.' Etymology unclear; flagged for parallels.
